title: Evidence Entry Schema
description: Schema for individual evidence entries in the Factory evidence registry. Each entry records a file artifact, its integrity hash, generation metadata, and links to supporting transcripts and verifier results.

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the evidence artifact file.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content at the time of recording.

size.description: File size in bytes. Optional but recommended.

nativeGenerated.description: Whether this artifact was natively generated during its declared phase.

reconstructedFrom.description: If reconstructed, path to the source evidence used for reconstruction.

phase.description: Factory phase during which this artifact was created.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence entry was recorded.

transcriptRef.description: Path to the worker transcript that covers the creation of this artifact.

verifierRefs.description: Paths to verifier result JSON files that reference this evidence entry.

agentId.description: Agent that created or owns this artifact.

compressionLevel.description: Context compression level of the session when this artifact was created.

contentType.description: MIME type or file extension category (e.g., application/json, text/markdown).

generatedBy.description: Script, agent role, or process that generated this artifact.

warnings.description: Any warnings associated with this evidence entry (e.g., SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE, compression-level warnings).

supersededBy.description: If this evidence entry has been superseded, path to the replacement entry.

supersedes.description: If this evidence entry supersedes a prior entry, path to the prior entry.
